verifications.claim: BTS is releasing their fifth studio album on March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Release Date 1 pm, Friday, March 20, 2026 (KST)'; R3: 'ARIRANG is scheduled for Friday, March 20, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states fifth album release on exact date in R1 and R3.

verifications.claim: BTS's fifth studio album is titled ARIRANG.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'BTS The 5th album, “ARIRANG,”'; R2: 'fifth studio album, Arirang'; R3: 'BTS’s fifth studio LP, ARIRANG'
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly name ARIRANG as the fifth studio album.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '14-track record'; R3: 'Fourteen songs, all told' with tracklist 1-14
verifications.reasoning: Both R2 and R3 list exactly 14 tracks.

verifications.claim: The title song of ARIRANG is "Swim".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'releasing a video for the song “Swim”'; R3: 'Led by the sweeping, water-themed single “SWIM”'
verifications.reasoning: Sources identify 'Swim'/'SWIM' as the lead single/title track.

verifications.claim: ARIRANG marks BTS's first full-group comeback in over three years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'first full-group album in three years and nine months'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states over three years (three years nine months).

verifications.claim: BTS's first full-group comeback follows the completion of their mandatory military service.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'served his mandatory military service in South Korea. But now they’re coming back'; R3: 'mandatory military-service timeline, spent the hiatus... and are now coming back'
verifications.reasoning: Both link comeback directly to post-military service completion.

verifications.claim: ARIRANG is BTS's first full-group album since Proof (2022).
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source mentions 'Proof' or specifies 2022 as the last album.

verifications.claim: A free livestreamed concert is scheduled for March 21, 2026, in Seoul.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'free concert at Seoul’s Gwanghwamun Square, which Netflix will livestream. On March 21'; R3: 'perform songs from it live for the first time at Seoul’s Gwanghwamun Square... streaming live on Netflix. On March 21'
verifications.reasoning: Both confirm free livestreamed concert on March 21 in Seoul.

verifications.claim: BTS's world tour begins on April 9, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'on April 9, they’ll embark on an 82-date world tour'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states world tour starts April 9.
